name: io.github.buildcontext/orca-mcp
title: orca-mcp
description: MCP bridge controlling Orca worktrees, sessions, and multi-agent orchestration.

environmentVariables.name: ORCA_BRIDGE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Master bridge token (≥16 chars). Required. Auth for stdio hosts and HTTP path-token/OAuth password.

environmentVariables.name: ORCA_CLI_COMMAND
environmentVariables.description: Override path/name of the Orca CLI binary (default: orca; Linux headless often orca-ide).

environmentVariables.name: ORCA_BRIDGE_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated capability tiers to enable (status,dispatch,admin). Default: all enabled.

environmentVariables.name: ORCA_BRIDGE_CLI_HARDENING
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to enforce the CLI action allowlist (recommended on shared hosts).

runtimeArguments.name: --rm
runtimeArguments.description: Remove container after exit (typical for stdio MCP hosts).

runtimeArguments.name: -i
runtimeArguments.description: Keep stdin open for MCP JSON-RPC.

environmentVariables.name: ORCA_CLI_COMMAND
environmentVariables.description: Override path/name of the Orca CLI binary inside the container network/namespace.
